display_name: WiSig 一致性实增益源筛查补充 DURA v1 同包对照
description: 在一致性实增益候选源训练期间固定 RX8 源 V 的 360 个物理包；候选与历史 R69 的 clean 和 low urban 预测全部冻结后独立同包评分。
authorization: 用户要求各数据集筛查对比 DURA，源 V 预测冻结后独立评分。

data.representation: 256-point source Full observations and frozen original reader/default head
data.physical_ids_ref: candidate screen.npz; equality against historical R69 predictions required

permissions.claim_scope: Source V developmental screen; historical V exposure; no target access or model fitting.

checkpoint.selection_rule: Low urban net at least +2 in each of two predetermined halves, clean net at least -2 overall; promotion also needs every candidate preregistered comparator. This is a supplemental preregistered baseline; if absent or incompatible, mark missing.

execution.launch_command: Run committed audit_wisig_dura_control.py via SSH standard input in candidate release, with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty and candidate run id as argument.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on incomplete frozen predictions, unmatched IDs or direct decisions, incorrect RX, or failed truth-last boundary.

rows.method: fixed consistency fusion versus fixed DURA v1 R69
rows.seed_notes: Model and split fixed by candidate; no new draws except predetermined halves and bootstrap; support not applicable.
rows.command: Read-only independent source audit after predictions freeze.

notes: Comparator and thresholds specified while candidate training is active, before its screen score.
Validate identical received-observation direct predictions before source truth linkage.
Reuse historical R69 predictions only if all physical IDs exist; preserve missing result otherwise.
